note: The Framework release the catalogue is checked and served against. The site loads the Framework from jsDelivr's npm form at ui.npm.version (the release's package; its package.json "simai" names the release and commit, and the gh/ form exceeds jsDelivr's size limit); the kit runs scripts/effect-kit.mjs from ui-source at ui_source.commit against ui's distr/core at ui.commit. The kit runs every check below that applies to a manifest: the base checks always, the per-scheme checks for each declared scheme, the dual checks when it draws both, pair when it names one, and a capability's checks when it declares it. A repin changes this file only.
